mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM mobility has stabilized at -46% to -52% over four weeks, indicating essential-goods trips are locked in. This floor in grocery traffic signals consumer confidence sufficient to resume discretionary retail visits, driving RETAIL_REC upward over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM variance is 6.3 percentage points across four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days remains below -85% or declines further relative to the last 28-day mean of -87.8%.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL mobility has plateaued at +32% to +34% for four consecutive weeks, indicating behavioral adaptation to lockdown is complete. Once this plateau persists, suppressed demand for retail-recreation will begin releasing as restrictions ease, causing RETAIL_REC to rise.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL remains within 1 percentage point of prior week for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL has not moved more than 1.1 percentage points week-on-week
regime_hint: steady state lockdown with adaptation complete
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL mobility rises above +35% or falls below +32% in the next two weeks, or RETAIL_REC does not increase within four weeks of RESIDENTIAL stabilization.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT stations remain at -84% to -85% across all four weeks. If TRANSIT mobility rises by more than 5 percentage points week-on-week, this signals policy-driven reopening of public transport, which directly enables retail-recreation access and drives RETAIL_REC upward.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises more than 5 percentage points from t-0w baseline
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT has remained between -84.1% and -85.6% with no upward trend
regime_hint: reopening phase initiated by transport policy
failure_condition: TRANSIT does not rise by more than 5 percentage points in the next week, or RETAIL_REC fails to increase within two weeks of a TRANSIT rise exceeding 5 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility has declined from -80.9% to -79.9% over three weeks, showing marginal recovery. When PARKS mobility rises above -75%, it signals outdoor-activity resumption that substitutes for indoor retail. This substitution effect will suppress RETAIL_REC growth over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises above -75% in any single week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS has shown minimal week-on-week volatility of 2.8 percentage points
failure_condition: PARKS does not rise above -75% within four weeks, or RETAIL_REC increases despite PARKS rising above -75%.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES and RETAIL_REC are both severely suppressed (-72% and -88% respectively at t-0w). When WORKPLACES mobility rises by more than 8 percentage points AND RESIDENTIAL remains stable (within 1 point), the joint signal indicates return-to-work confidence that restores commuting-adjacent retail visits, lifting RETAIL_REC.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises more than 8 percentage points AND RESIDENTIAL change is less than 1 percentage point in the same week
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES has ranged -70% to -73.6% with no sustained recovery
failure_condition: WORKPLACES and RESIDENTIAL do not satisfy the joint trigger condition within two weeks, or RETAIL_REC fails to increase within four weeks of the trigger being met.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM and TRANSIT are both severely suppressed and stable. If both series rise simultaneously by more than 3 percentage points in the same week, this signals coordinated reopening of essential and transport infrastructure, enabling retail-recreation access and driving RETAIL_REC upward.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM and TRANSIT both rise more than 3 percentage points in the same week
evidence_refs: fact:Both series show tight clustering with minimal variance
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM and TRANSIT do not both rise more than 3 percentage points in any single week within the next four weeks, or RETAIL_REC does not increase within two weeks of the joint trigger.

mechanism_narrative: Mid-April in Victoria marks the onset of autumn. Seasonal demand for indoor retail-recreation (cafes, shopping centers) typically rises as outdoor activities become less attractive. This seasonal effect will overcome lockdown suppression, causing RETAIL_REC to rise over the next four weeks regardless of other mobility signals.
evidence_refs: fact:Decision point is 2020-04-15, autumn transition period in Southern Hemisphere
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days does not exceed the prior 28-day mean, or PARKS mobility increases above -70% (indicating sustained outdoor preference despite seasonal shift).

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES at -72% and TRANSIT at -85% indicate severe restrictions remain in force. If WORKPLACES rises above -60% while TRANSIT remains below -80%, this signals selective workplace reopening without full transport restoration, creating bottlenecks that suppress RETAIL_REC access and prevent recovery.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises above -60% AND TRANSIT remains below -80% in the same week
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT has not risen above -84.1% in any of the four weeks
failure_condition: WORKPLACES does not rise above -60% within two weeks, or TRANSIT rises above -80% simultaneously with WORKPLACES, or RETAIL_REC increases despite the asymmetric reopening pattern.
